- Note 2 (Security DB): role Engineer (same value as note 1), employment type contractor (from Security DB, authoritative), security training basic, recommendation: read. Comment: contractor with basic security training, never admin, write requires advanced training, so max is read. Recommending read.

The Security agent says Security DB is authoritative for employment type. So Terri is a contractor with basic security training.

For contractors: read, or write if advanced security training. Never admin. Basic training → max is read.

Requested level: admin. Maximum: read. So grant maximum = read.

Wait, but there's a conflict between HR (full-time, recommends write) and Security (contractor, recommends read). The Security note says Security DB is authoritative for employment type. As Approver, I need to decide. The maximum under contractor status is read. Under full-time Engineer, max is write (since Engineer doesn't own Payroll, only admin if role owns system; full-time up to write). 

Which to trust? The notes say Security DB is authoritative for employment type. So contractor, basic training → read.

So decision: read.

Let me submit read with reasoning.
